scope: P004 explicit-security local research and manual public company-profile consumer
clock: source timestamps separate; capturedAt is local UTC capture only
notes: explicit manual save with original baseline compare; per-security drafts survive reload/switch/reopen; explicit discard
snapshots: immutable bundle plus manual snapshot text, independent of later quotes/docs
sourceLocation: exact frozen doc expected record; host checks current-record equality and unsaved target draft before opening
import: validate whole file; preview no write; cancel no write; stale entire store abort; duplicates skip; conflicts retain; atomic inserts
unavailable: no zero/future fill, bare-code inference, automatic polling, credential/model/purchase/trade call; only explicit manual three-source public GET is enabled outside testing
remainingLegacy: news/AI and manual tape calculation remain independent gaps unless existing verified native data/routes supplied; public F10 availability is separately unverified

companyProfile.identity: same full bundle id; stock only
companyProfile.raw: whole per-source JSON, original timestamps and report dates; overview excerpts plus paged original reader
companyProfile.fetch: explicit manual update/cancel only;8s source transfer,12s action deadline; no redirect/retry
companyProfile.cache: 30days; failure retains payload/fetchedAt; checked whole-file baseline and atomic replace, process-wide cooperative writer lock; external TOCTOU remains
companyProfile.timestampComparison: exact seconds plus nanoseconds; original strings retained
companyProfile.history: immutable research snapshots; no implicit source refresh
